title: QubeYards Real Estate Platform Frontend - Property Transactions, Admin UI, News Section, and Partner Currency

requirements.summary: Add pan-India location support with UI indicators and filtering for any Indian city or state
acceptanceCriteria: Properties can be listed from any location in India
Location filter supports Indian cities and states
UI indicates pan-India coverage availability

file_operations.description: Update location search filter to support Indian cities and states with improved placeholder text indicating pan-India coverage (e.g., 'Search by city or state (Pan-India)'). Ensure the location filter correctly handles property location values passed from backend.
Add a visual indicator or badge near the property statistics section that highlights pan-India coverage availability (e.g., 'Properties available across India').

requirements.summary: Create an offers display section on the main dashboard showing a single prominent offer line
acceptanceCriteria: Offers section is visible on the main dashboard
Display shows one prominent offer line
Offer text is clear and attention-grabbing

file_operations.description: Add an offers banner section between the hero banner and property statistics that displays a single prominent offer line with attention-grabbing styling using QubeYards brand colors. Position it prominently at the top of the page content.

requirements.summary: Add project stage categorization (pre-launch, launch, ready-to-shift) to property listing interface with filtering
acceptanceCriteria: Property model includes project stage field with options: pre-launch, launch, ready-to-shift
Property list can be filtered by project stage
Project stage is displayed on property cards
All three stages are selectable in filters

file_operations.description: Display the projectStage field from the Property type (which includes preLaunch, launch, readyToShift values) as a badge or label on each property card with appropriate styling and human-readable labels (e.g., 'Pre-Launch', 'Launch', 'Ready to Shift').

Add a project stage filter dropdown with options for pre-launch, launch, and ready-to-shift. Use the getPropertiesByProjectStage backend capability when a specific stage is selected. Display all three stage options with clear labels.
Add a useGetPropertiesByProjectStage query hook that calls actor.getPropertiesByProjectStage(projectStage) to support filtered property retrieval by project stage.

requirements.summary: Add property approval workflow UI where new property listings show pending status and admins can approve properties
acceptanceCriteria: New property listings start in pending approval status
Admins see a list of pending properties requiring approval
Approved properties become visible in main property list
Property submitters can see their pending submissions

file_operations.description: Display the status field from Property type including pendingApproval status with a distinct visual indicator (e.g., yellow badge). For admin users, add an 'Approve' button on pendingApproval properties that calls the approveProperty backend capability.

Create an admin-only page that displays properties with pendingApproval status in a dedicated view. Include approve action buttons that trigger actor.approveProperty(propertyId). Use the authorization component to enforce admin-only access by checking isCallerAdmin() and showing an access denied message for non-admins. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Filter the displayed properties to exclude pendingApproval status for non-admin users. For admin users, show all properties including pending ones or provide a toggle to view pending properties separately.

Add useApproveProperty mutation hook that calls actor.approveProperty(propertyId) and invalidates the properties query cache on success. Add useIsCallerAdmin query hook that calls actor.isCallerAdmin() to determine admin status.
Add a route for '/admin/properties' that renders AdminPropertiesPage component. Ensure this route is wrapped with authentication guard.
Add a conditional navigation link 'Pending Approvals' to the header that appears only for admin users (checked via useIsCallerAdmin hook) and routes to '/admin/properties'.

requirements.summary: Create a news and magazine section accessible from main navigation that displays real estate news articles
acceptanceCriteria: News/Magazine link appears in main navigation
News section displays articles in magazine-style layout
Articles include headlines, images, and publication dates
Content is organized and easy to browse

file_operations.description: Create a news and magazine section page with a magazine-style layout displaying real estate news articles. Include the generated header image from frontend/public/assets/generated/news-header.dim_1200x400.png. Display articles with headlines, placeholder images, and publication dates. Use a grid layout for article cards with modern, browsable design suitable for QubeYards branding.
Add a route for '/news' that renders the NewsPage component. Ensure it is accessible to all users (no authentication required).
Add a 'News & Magazine' link in the main navigation header that routes to '/news'. Position it prominently alongside existing Dashboard, Leads, and Commissions links.

requirements.summary: Display QubeYards currency balance prominently in partner dashboard showing total earned currency and recent transactions
acceptanceCriteria: Currency balance is visible on partner dashboard
Balance shows total QubeYards currency earned
Recent currency transactions are listed with details
Currency icon or branding is used consistently

file_operations.description: Create a card component that displays the partner's QubeYards currency balance with the generated currency icon from frontend/public/assets/generated/currency-icon.dim_128x128.png. Use large, prominent typography for the balance amount and include QubeYards branding with gold accent colors.

Add the CurrencyBalanceCard component to the dashboard page in a prominent position near the top, alongside or above the property statistics. Show the balance only for authenticated partners with partner role.

Add useGetQubeYardsBalance query hook that calls actor.getQubeYardsBalance() to fetch the current partner's currency balance. Ensure it is only called when the user is authenticated with partner role.

requirements.summary: Restrict channel partner features so only authenticated users with partner role can access partner-specific functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Partner-specific features require partner role authentication
Non-partners cannot access partner dashboard sections
Partner role is assigned during registration or by admin
Role-based access control is enforced on backend

file_operations.description: Enhance the AuthGuard component to support role-based access by accepting an optional requiredRole prop. When requiredRole is provided, check the user's role via getCallerUserRole() and display an access denied message if the user does not have the required role. Use the authorization component to verify role-checking patterns before implementing.

Wrap partner-specific routes (dashboard with currency, leads, commissions) with AuthGuard that requires partner role or admin role. Ensure public routes like News remain accessible without role restrictions.
Add useGetCallerUserRole query hook that calls actor.getCallerUserRole() to retrieve the current user's role for role-based UI rendering decisions.

requirements.summary: Update branding throughout the application to use QubeYards name, logo, and identity consistently
acceptanceCriteria: App name is QubeYards across all pages
Navigation and footer display QubeYards branding
Page titles and metadata reference QubeYards
Consistent brand identity is maintained

file_operations.description: Replace the current app name and branding with 'QubeYards' throughout the header and footer. Display the generated QubeYards logo from frontend/public/assets/generated/qubeyards-logo.dim_200x80.png in the header navigation. Update footer text to reference QubeYards branding consistently.
Update the page title to 'QubeYards - Premium Real Estate Platform' and add appropriate meta tags referencing QubeYards in the description.

Update the hero banner section to reference QubeYards branding and use the generated luxury hero image from frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-luxury.dim_1920x600.png. Include QubeYards name in prominent hero text.
Update branding references to QubeYards with the logo from frontend/public/assets/generated/qubeyards-logo.dim_200x80.png and ensure all text refers to QubeYards as the platform name.

requirements.summary: Create a modern, premium visual design system for QubeYards with deep teals, golds, and whites
acceptanceCriteria: Color scheme uses premium teal, gold, and white tones
Typography is clean and professional
Layout feels luxurious and modern
Design conveys trust and sophistication
Visual hierarchy guides user attention effectively

file_operations.description: Update the CSS custom properties to define a premium color palette featuring deep teal (#0F766E, #115E59), gold (#D97706, #F59E0B), and white (#FFFFFF) tones. Replace the current earth-toned palette with these luxury colors while maintaining the OKLCH color space structure for both light and dark modes.

Update the Tailwind configuration to reference the new premium teal and gold color variables. Ensure the color scheme supports sophisticated, modern layouts with proper contrast ratios for accessibility. Add any custom shadows or effects that enhance the luxury aesthetic.

Apply the new premium design system with teal and gold accents to property cards. Use clean typography, sophisticated spacing, and professional imagery presentation that conveys luxury real estate branding.

Update the header and footer styling to use the premium teal and gold color palette. Apply clean, modern typography and ensure the layout conveys sophistication and trust consistent with luxury real estate positioning.
